# Bid the building, not the square footage.

> Price a commercial cleaning contract from production rates, day-porter shifts, and periodic floor care, see what a 5× to 3× cut actually costs, whether letting the building buy the paper still holds your margin, and whether throwing in the initial clean loses month 1.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
